package.author: ADInstruments NZ Limited
package.description: The Blood Pressure Module adds functionality to LabChart to identify and analyze various parameters of human and animal ventricular and arterial pressure recordings.

en-US.author: ADInstruments NZ Limited
en-US.description: The Blood Pressure Module adds functionality to LabChart to identify and analyze various parameters of human and animal ventricular and arterial pressure recordings.
en-US.longDescription: The Blood Pressure Module adds functionality to LabChart to identify and analyze various parameters of human and animal ventricular and arterial pressure recordings. Analysis can be performed in both real time or after recording and includes a Classifier feature for detection and exclusion of atypical waveforms.
en-US.name: ADInstruments Blood Pressure

zh-CN.description: 血压模块为 LabChart 增加了识别和分析人类及动物心室与动脉压力记录各项参数的功能。
zh-CN.longDescription: 血压模块为 LabChart 增加了识别和分析人类及动物心室与动脉压力记录各项参数的功能。该模块支持实时或记录后分析，并包含波形分类器功能，可检测并排除非典型波形。

package.longDescription: The Blood Pressure Module adds functionality to LabChart to identify and analyze various parameters of human and animal ventricular and arterial pressure recordings.
